hero.title: Good questions are welcome.
hero.text: Here are a few starting points about adoption, fostering, volunteering, donations, and surrender requests.

questions.question: Where can I see cats available for adoption?
questions.answer: Current listings are available on our Adopt page.

questions.question: Can I apply before choosing a specific cat?
questions.answer: Yes. An application can start the conversation even if you are still looking for a match.

questions.question: How do meet-and-greets work?
questions.answer: After application approval, the team can arrange a visit. Cats live in foster homes, so visits are planned rather than walk-ins.

questions.question: Where do foster cats stay?
questions.answer: Feline Fairies is foster-based. Cats stay in volunteer homes rather than a shelter building.

questions.question: How do I express interest in fostering?
questions.answer: Start with the foster application. A volunteer can follow up about current needs and a suitable next step.

questions.question: What kinds of help might be useful?
questions.answer: Needs can include events, cat care, transport, and behind-the-scenes work. Availability and needs can change.

questions.question: How can I donate online?
questions.answer: The Donate page connects you to Feline Fairies’ PayPal donation flow.

questions.question: What do donations support?
questions.answer: Gifts help with food, supplies, foster needs, safe housing, and basic medical care.

questions.question: Can Feline Fairies accept every surrender request?
questions.answer: No acceptance can be promised. The surrender request form gives the volunteer team the information needed to review the situation and current capacity.

cta.title: Ask us directly.
cta.text: Send a question and we’ll help point you toward the right next step.
